description: Plug a source into your entity — docs, an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server, an llms.txt, a URL, a repo (https), or one of your data attachments. Fetched on a public-address-only rail and stored as DATA (a digest + summary). ≤20 per entity. Owner, JWT.

id.description: a page/agent handle, a listing slug, or a record/product uuid

kind.description: any registered kind (GET /api/entities/kinds): page, rig, skill, harness, mcp, agent, product, harness_record (any harness type), rig_record (any rig or sub-rig)

name: entity_source_add
title: Entity Source Add
